prior.s9_finding: Full static hybrid passed variable-binding transfer; online fast-TTT failed strict all-seed robustness; neither independently qualified.

question: On the already-qualified synthetic association task, what is the effect on novel flexible variable-binding performance of removing Mamba2, causal attention, or the TTT layer from the original native hybrid? Does enabling TTT inner updates improve the full model?

design.method: Newly train each ablation from scratch; do not turn off pretrained components post hoc. Instantiate the same original official Mamba2+TTT native modules at matched initialization, bypass only specified blocks in forward, freeze bypassed parameters. All active blocks remain official/unchanged. Fixed depth and output preserved.
design.interpretation_limit: Leave-one-out architectures differ in active trainable parameters and compute; associations are causal effects of a removal under the frozen training recipe, not independent intelligence/generalization results or equal-capacity superiority.
design.full_model_equivalence: For active-all full static/online, verify forward of adapter is bit-for-bit equal to original AuthenticHybrid.forward with identical state before training.
design.data_equivalence: All arms see identical training episodes and targets, same optimizer-step and episode budget. Model-specific changes to active trainable parameter count and wall/FLOPs are measured.

arms.type: qualified S6 conventional explicit key-value content retrieval
original official Mamba2 + causal attention + outer TTTLinear (inner updates disabled) + depth
attention + outer TTTLinear (inner updates disabled) + depth; Mamba skipped
official nonfused Mamba2 + outer TTTLinear (inner updates disabled) + depth; causal attention skipped
official nonfused Mamba2 + causal attention + depth; entire TTTLinear skipped
original official Mamba2 + causal attention + outer TTTLinear (inner updates enabled) + depth

training.source: Exact G7-S6 get_batch (git blob above), seed*10000000+step*17

evaluation.permutation: Reuse G7-S9 per-example deterministic nonidentity query and pair permutations, with targets shuffled with their queries; no target leaks.
negative_controls: oracle exact correct and joint 0 MSE

scientific_reporting.model_component_contribution: COMPONENT_CONTRIBUTION_SIGNAL only if both frozen ratio ≥2, absolute error increase ≥0.01 and worse on ALL THREE seeds; even this is conditional, not proof fundamental necessity and is not matched parameter/FLOP test.
scientific_reporting.model_component_not_demonstrated: NO_COMPONENT_CONTRIBUTION_DEMONSTRATED when thresholds unmet; absence of evidence not evidence of no useful contribution on other tasks.
scientific_reporting.online_ttt: EXTRA_ONLINE_TTT_BENEFIT only when ≥5% error reduction over full_static on joint permuted split AND all 3 seeds favor online; otherwise ONLINE_TTT_ADVANTAGE_NULL.
scientific_reporting.science_status: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY, never SCIENTIFIC_PASS. No independence, full final regression, language understanding or learning outside this synthetic task established.

stop: missing official Mamba2/TTT SHA or signed Python headers
